items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: No. Joining Koina is completely free and will stay that way. The community works imece style: everyone shares what they know and their time; server and event costs are covered openly by sponsors and volunteer support.

items.question: Can I just watch?
items.answer: Of course. Watching streams, hanging out on Discord and reading the newsletter are all ways to take part. Nobody pushes you to code; you take a small step when you feel ready.

items.question: How much do I need to know to join as a participant?
items.answer: If you can use Git and write a small program in at least one language, you're ready. Every project has issues for every level, and there's an open pairing hour on Wednesday evenings when you get stuck.

items.question: How much time does mentoring take?
items.answer: Two to three hours a week for six weeks: a 45-minute team sync and at least three PR reviews. Every mentor who takes their team to Demo Day gets a verified mentorship record on their profile.

items.question: Can I use AI tools?
items.answer: Yes. One rule: say so in the PR description and be able to explain the code you send. Sending code you don't understand is not allowed; using tools is.
